transcript: Five signs your mental health may be getting worse, especially after 50. Number one, little things make you snap. The dishes in the sink, a phone call, someone asking one small question. It is not that you became a bad person. It is that your heart has been carrying too much for too long. Number two, you do not enjoy the things you used to love. Cooking used to feel peaceful. Music used to make you smile. Seeing family used to give you energy. But now everything feels like another task. Number three, you keep saying, I just want to be alone. Not because you are resting, but because talking to people feels exhausting. You stop answering messages, you avoid calls, and slowly the house becomes quiet in a way that does not feel peaceful. Number four, your appetite has changed. Some women eat all day just to feel comfort. Others lose interest in food completely. Both can be signs that something inside is asking for care. Number five, you wake up tired even after sleeping. Your body is moving, but your spirit feels heavy. You do what needs to be done, but there is no joy in it. Listen carefully. You are not weak. You are not too old, and you are not broken. Sometimes the woman who took care of everyone else finally needs someone to take care of her. If this sounds like you, I put my 30-day healing journey in the link on my profile. Follow for more old monk healing lessons.
